Xi Jinping Invites 100,000 Young Americans to China

Chinese President Xi Jinping has extended an invitation to 100,000 young Americans to visit China for exchanges and study. This initiative comes as Xi Jinping and Donald Trump reportedly seek closer ties. The invitation aims to foster greater understanding and connection between the youth of the two nations.
